caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair. The chair is colored in various shades of green, with some areas highlighted in yellow and white to suggest dimension and light reflection. The chair has a curved top rail, four vertical spindles forming the backrest, and a scooped seat. The legs are rounded and turned, featuring horizontal stretchers connecting the front legs to the back legs for stability. The chair is positioned upright and centered within a rectangular outline, all set against a plain, light background. There is a signature in cursive in the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Wooden Chair
